title: Event
description: An event delivered to the cadence enforcer's decide() function. Describes a lifecycle moment for a specific agent. Defined in CONTRACTS.md §3.1.

schema_version.description: Protocol schema version. MUST be '1.0' for this revision.

event_type.description: Discriminator for the event. 'tool_used' fires on any tool call completion; 'channel_send' / 'channel_recv' fire on SOX tool calls specifically; 'turn_started' fires when the agent begins a new LLM turn; 'stop_requested' fires when the agent is about to exit.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the agent that produced this event.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch seconds (floating point) at which the event occurred.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool that was called. Populated for event_type 'tool_used'; SHOULD be null for all other event types.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs for adapter-specific context. Implementations MUST NOT rely on any particular metadata field for core enforcer logic.
